# Sakura Player v1.2.0-beta.2

**Sakura Player 公开测试版 v1.2.0-beta.2 / Sakura Player Public Beta v1.2.0-beta.2**

## 简体中文

Sakura Player 是由 Sakura520222 维护的 [SPlayer-Next](https://github.com/SPlayer-Dev/SPlayer-Next) 非官方 Fork。v1.2.0-beta.2 是 Sakura Player 的第二个公开测试版本，在此前 v1.2.0-beta.1 的基础上带来了本地歌词保存与导出、歌词副行字号配置、灵动岛暂停隐藏等新特性，并同步了上游关于播放竞态、日志上报及收藏凭据的多项重要修复。

### 新增与改进

- **本地歌词保存与文件导出**：
  - 复制歌词弹窗中新增“保存完整歌词”功能，支持将在线/本地解析后的完整歌词（包括翻译、音译等元数据）直接写入本地音频文件标签（内嵌歌词）。
  - 支持将当前歌词单独导出为同名 `.lrc` 文件，或在开启本地 TTML 覆盖库时保存为 `.ttml` 文件。
  - 针对标签写入后的重载流程增加了状态快照保护，避免切歌与保存并发时的歌词覆盖风险。
- **歌词排版与副行字号自定义**：
  - 新增翻译/音译副行独立字号设置 (`translationFontSize`)，在 lyric-dom 与 AMLL 两款歌词引擎中统一生效。
  - 主字号下限放宽至 12px，主副字号滑块档位统一规范为 12 / 24 / 36 / 48 / 64。
  - 副行透明度合成逻辑对齐旧版 SPlayer（恒定 0.6 基础透明度，明暗统一由行级透明度驱动）。
- **灵动岛体验优化**：
  - 灵动岛设置中新增“暂停时隐藏”配置选项，在播放暂停或停止时可自动收起隐藏，恢复播放后自动显示。
- **界面与构建改进**：
  - 调整下载列表与歌曲列表的表头文字样式，修复紧凑布局下文字可能重叠的问题。
  - 在致谢/关于页的 GitHub 贡献者列表中将当前仓库作者置顶展示。
  - 原生模块构建脚本（`scripts/build-native.ts`）增加编译失败自动重试机制，提升本地与 CI 构建稳定性。

### 同步上游修复

- **播放核心与竞态修复**：
  - 修复音源恢复重试期间用户切换播放/暂停或切歌时的并发竞态，避免状态错乱或残留播放。
  - 修复网易云单曲循环模式下播放计时器与进度重置异常。
  - 修复播放日志与打点（Scrobble）上报逻辑。
- **音乐服务接入**：
  - 修复网易云收藏/喜欢歌曲请求的身份凭据，支持无版权或无音源歌曲自动跳过播放下一首。
- **发布与维护流程**：
  - 优化每夜构建（Nightly）更新日志生成范围与展示。

### 下载与更新

| 平台    | 架构        | 包格式                                            |
| ------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| Windows | x64 / ARM64 | 安装版 `.exe`、便携版 `.exe`                      |
| macOS   | x64 / ARM64 | `.dmg`、`.zip`                                    |
| Linux   | x64 / ARM64 | `.AppImage`、`.deb`、`.rpm`、`.tar.gz`、`.pacman` |

按设备架构选择发行页中的文件。Beta 版本不向 Stable 通道提供更新；已订阅 Beta 通道（或首发默认订阅）的用户可在新版本发布后接收更新。Nightly 使用独立的滚动发行和更新清单。草稿不提供公开下载或自动更新。

### 已知限制

- 这是测试版本，仍可能存在潜在问题。Windows 本地构建与基础冒烟已完成；macOS/Linux 和 ARM64 尚需真实设备上的安装、播放与更新验证，CI 构建成功不能替代这些验证。升级或迁移前请备份配置与音乐库。
- Windows 包目前未做代码签名；macOS 包未做签名和公证，系统可能显示信任提示。请仅使用本仓库发行页的资源。
- macOS、Windows 便携版及 Linux 解压版提供更新检查和外部下载；应用内下载安装仅对支持的安装形式开放。任务栏歌词和 WASAPI 独占输出仅适用于 Windows。
- 不自动导入上游便携数据。启用或卸载 `orpheus://` 集成不会保证恢复此前的用户选择；macOS 与上游共存时的链接处理仍需验证。
- Discord RPC 默认关闭，暂时保留上游 Application ID、资源和身份。独立 Sakura Player Discord 身份仍需维护者注册真实应用并提供资源。
- 在线音乐、歌词及其他第三方服务的可用性取决于各自的接口、账号与服务规则。已有兼容接口保留，不保证第三方服务持续可用。

### 来源与许可证

本项目继续按 **GNU AGPL-3.0** 发布。保留原始作者 imsyy、SPlayer-Next 贡献者和第三方组件的版权、许可证及署名。本版本的[对应源代码](https://github.com/Sakura520222/Sakura-Player/tree/v1.2.0-beta.2)、[LICENSE](https://github.com/Sakura520222/Sakura-Player/blob/v1.2.0-beta.2/LICENSE) 和 [NOTICE](https://github.com/Sakura520222/Sakura-Player/blob/v1.2.0-beta.2/NOTICE) 与发行物一并提供；软件按许可证条款不提供担保。

## English

Sakura Player is an **unofficial fork** of [SPlayer-Next](https://github.com/SPlayer-Dev/SPlayer-Next), maintained by Sakura520222. It is independent of the upstream project and is not an official upstream release. Version v1.2.0-beta.2 is the second public Beta release of Sakura Player, introducing new features such as full lyric saving to tags, optional lyric file exports, configurable secondary lyric font size, and dynamic island auto-hide on pause, alongside syncing critical upstream fixes for playback race conditions, scrobble reporting, and favorite request credentials.

### Features & Improvements

- **Full Lyric Tag Saving & File Export**:
  - Added a "Save Full Lyrics" section to the Copy Lyrics dialog, enabling direct writing of online/local resolved lyrics (including translation and romaji metadata) into local audio file tags (embedded lyrics).
  - Added options to export lyrics as a matching `.lrc` file or `.ttml` file (when the local TTML override directory is configured).
  - Added state snapshot protection during save-and-reload to prevent lyric race conditions when tracks transition.
- **Customizable Lyric Typography & Sub-line Font Size**:
  - Added an independent secondary font size setting (`translationFontSize`) for translated/romaji lines, supported across both lyric-dom and AMLL engines.
  - Lower bound of primary lyric font size relaxed to 12px; unified slider range and steps for both font size controls to 12 / 24 / 36 / 48 / 64.
  - Restored classic SPlayer opacity blending for secondary lines (constant 0.6 base opacity, brightness modulated by line-level state).
- **Dynamic Island Enhancements**:
  - Added an option to automatically hide the dynamic island when playback is paused or stopped, reappearing smoothly when playback resumes.
- **UI & Build System Polish**:
  - Adjusted header text styling in download and song lists to prevent text overlapping in narrow layouts.
  - Pinned repository author to the top of the GitHub contributors list on the About/Credits page.
  - Added auto-retry logic to native module builds (`scripts/build-native.ts`) to improve build resilience on network/compilation hiccups.

### Upstream Fixes Synced

- **Playback Core & Concurrency**:
  - Fixed a race condition between pause/track switching and background audio source recovery, preventing playback glitches or orphaned audio streams.
  - Fixed single-track loop timer reset and playback progress calculation.
  - Fixed playback scrobble and history logging reporting.
- **Music Service Integrations**:
  - Fixed credential handling for Netease favorite/like requests, and ensured songs without playable audio sources or copyright access are skipped automatically.
- **Release & Workflow Improvements**:
  - Improved Nightly release notes generation range and display.

### Packages and updates

Windows provides installer and portable `.exe` packages; macOS provides `.dmg` and `.zip`; Linux provides `.AppImage`, `.deb`, `.rpm`, `.tar.gz` and `.pacman`. Every platform targets both x64 and ARM64. Choose the architecture matching your device.

Beta releases do not update Stable subscribers. Future stable releases can reach Beta/Alpha subscribers. Nightly has a separate rolling release and update feed. Drafts are not publicly downloadable or discoverable by automatic updates.

### Known limitations

- This is a test release. Local Windows builds and basic smoke testing are complete; macOS/Linux and ARM64 still require installation, playback and update checks on real devices. Passing CI builds does not replace those checks. Back up settings and the library before upgrading or migrating.
- Windows packages are unsigned, and macOS packages are unsigned and not notarized. The OS may display trust prompts. Download only from this repository's release page.
- macOS, Windows portable and Linux archive builds offer update checks and external downloads. In-app download/install is available only for supported installation types. Taskbar lyrics and WASAPI exclusive output are Windows-only.
- Upstream portable data is not imported automatically. Disabling or uninstalling Orpheus integration does not guarantee restoration of a previous user choice; macOS link handling with both applications installed still needs validation.
- Discord RPC is disabled by default and temporarily retains the upstream Application ID, assets and identity. An independent Sakura Player Discord identity requires a real maintainer-owned application and assets.
- Online music, lyrics and other third-party integrations depend on their services, accounts and rules. Compatible interfaces are retained, but continued third-party availability is not guaranteed.
